responsibility: This machine description defines the detailed DFA scheduling model for the P5600 core, including both scalar and MSA/vector execution. It describes address-generation and arithmetic queues, branch/load/store resources, GP divide support, floating-point short and long pipelines, MSA operation classes, and scalar integer/FP reservations and bypasses, providing the main scheduler model for MIPS32r5 p5600 tuning and its vector-capable execution engine.
